description: Agent GovCon: submit a contract modification with the base award and the modifications before it: the modification with its number, the contract number it changes, how it describes itself (administrative, funding, scope, option exercise or extension), each change to the work it makes, the currency, its change in obligated funding, the funded total it states after the change, the last day of performance after it, and each party who signed it; the award with its contract number, currency, obligated funding at award, the last day of the base period, each option period with its last day, and each party it names to sign; and each prior modification with its number and funding change. The signed report gives the modification and the award, the funded total recomputed from the award’s funding and every change since, a change to the work read against how the modification describes itself, the new end of performance read against the latest end the option terms allow, and each signatory read against the parties the award names, and counts them, and names a divergent modification: a funding change that does not recompute against the prior modifications, a scope change described as administrative, a period extension beyond the award’s option terms, and a signature by a party the award does not name; then another currency, a funding change in an administrative modification, another contract number and a repeated modification number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No award funding, no funding change or funded total, no description, no end of performance on either record, or no named parties or signatories leaves those points unverified. The funding recomputes to the cent, a prior modification with no stated change counting as none, and signatories read as parties. This reads a contract action against the award it changes: wever_contract-diff-check diffs two contract drafts against each other, while the modification check reads a modification against the base award and the modifications before it. Verdict govcon_modification_divergent, govcon_modification_partial, govcon_modification_unverified or govcon_modification_consistent. POST /api/govcon-modification-check. Reads the government contracting records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between contracting documents only: it never submits a bid or proposal, never registers or certifies a vendor in any government system, never contacts an agency and never decides eligibility or award, which stay with the contracting agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent GovCon reads government contracting records across the procurement lifecycle for consistency between the documents and the terms they answer to: a solicitation, a vendor’s eligibility record, a proposal or bid, a price proposal or pricing volume, an award notice, a contract modification, a deliverable or progress report and an invoice or payment voucher, each against its own sections and the notice it follows, the solicitation’s set-aside, eligibility, submission and pricing terms, the winning price and eligibility record, the base award and prior modifications, the deliverable schedule, or the payment terms and acceptance record it should agree with. The family reads procurement, the government buying goods and services under contract terms, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-govcon-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-govcon/.
